title: Ship-gate pre-PR commit options
summary: Ship-gate now asks before the first commit or push: when committing is best, plus numbered options to commit, open a PR, save WIP, or keep working uncommitted.
changes: Add a Before PR / commit gate to the ship-gate agent rule and skill, including when-to-commit guidance.
Offer Next-actions options for commit and PR, commit only, WIP checkpoint, keep uncommitted, or stop.
Document the commit gate in the AGENTS.md end-of-work checklist before open/update PR.
version_rationale: Patch release: agent workflow documentation only; no end-user product behaviour change.
validation: Reviewed ship-gate rule and skill Next-actions format against existing merge/deploy/release gates.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main after filling release notes.
known_limitations: Commit and push still require an explicit operator or user pick; agents do not auto-commit.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To remove the commit gate, restore the prior ship-gate rule and skill without the Before PR section.
provenance: Defined by the ship-gate pre-PR commit gate work for MyAPES Account issue #169 and pull request #170.
